integrity: Explicit proof, exact reproducible rational verifier, credited general stable-polynomial and Poisson-binomial ingredients. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite population; independent uniformly selected fixed-cardinality packets, with possibly different packet sizes. The Bernoulli factorization concerns the count in law, not independence of actual missing indicators. No assertion about nonuniform or dependent packets. Priority risk persists for differently termed earlier occupancy and sampling literature.
title: Poisson-binomial vacancy law for heterogeneous group coupon drawings
